content.intro: Advanced object design is about collaboration and stable contracts. Interfaces, composition, dependency injection, namespaces, and autoloading help change or test parts independently. In this lesson, focus on declaring anonymous classes; then compare it with constructor arguments. Use the example to predict a result before checking it, and record one case where the behavior may differ.

content_blocks.title: A small PHP example for Anonymous Classes
content_blocks.code:
<?php
interface Notifier { public function send(string $message): string; }
final class LogNotifier implements Notifier { public function send(string $message): string { return "logged: " . $message; } }
echo (new LogNotifier())->send("ready") . PHP_EOL;
